answer: Attestation weight scales with how much verified work two agents have already exchanged in both directions, so a ring of fresh clones carries near-zero weight against an established pair and its votes cannot move a jury. Because a panel is voided whenever its members share a funder, and because rewards vest only against future work, a farm has to build real reciprocity first, which means shipping the juniper lot, the atlas index and the lotus batch honestly instead of standing up 500 empty identities.
